```{r setup}
format_pval_plain <- function(p) {
  if (p < 0.001) {
    exp <- floor(log10(p))
    paste0("p < 1e", exp)
  } else {
    sprintf("p = %.3f", p)
  }
}
```

# Whittle et al. 2026

```{r}
subset_dat_file <- "../data/whittle2026_sc_atlas_AML_BM/data/AML_scAtlas_Jan2026_subset.h5ad"
if(params$subset == TRUE & file.exists(subset_dat_file)){
  dat <- readRDS(subset_dat_file)
} else {
  library(zellkonverter)
  dat <- readH5AD(file = "../data/whittle2026_sc_atlas_AML_BM/data/AML_scAtlas_Jan2026.h5ad.gz", reader = "R")
  # Supplement with gene symbols -------------------------------------------------
  rowData(dat)$gene_symbol  <- rownames(dat)
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)
  genes <- rownames(dat)

  genes_clean <- sub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", genes)

  ens_vec <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys     = genes_clean,
    keytype  = "SYMBOL",
    column   = "ENSEMBL",
    multiVals = "first"
  )
  ens_ids <- data.frame(
    SYMBOL         = genes,
    cleaned_symbol = genes_clean,
    ENSEMBL        = ens_vec,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  new_rownames <- ifelse(
    is.na(ens_ids$ENSEMBL),
    ens_ids$SYMBOL,
    ens_ids$ENSEMBL
  )
  rownames(dat) <- new_rownames
  dat <- dat[!duplicated(rownames(dat)), ]

}
```

## Figure 7F: SLC6A8 expression

```{r}
# ==== Setup ====
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrastr)
library(patchwork)

pal_status <- c(Healthy = "#3B7EA1", AML = "#C0392B")
pal_expr   <- c("#FDD49E", "#FC8D59", "#D7301F", "#7F0000")

pal_celltype <- c(HSPC = "#F28E2B", CMP = "#8C564B", GMP = "#FFD92F", MEP = "#E15759",
                  Erythroid = "#FF9DA7", ProMono = "#1B7837", `CD14+ Mono` = "#7FBC41",
                  `CD16+ Mono` = "#B8E186", cDC = "#35978F", pDC = "#80CDC1",
                  ProB = "#C2A5CF", B = "#9970AB", Plasma = "#40004B",
                  T = "#4E79A7", NK = "#A0CBE8", Stromal = "grey50")
pal_cat  <- c(Erythroid = "#D95F02", Leukemic = "#7570B3", Other = "grey88")
pal_rate <- c("#FFF7EC", "#FDD49E", "#FC8D59", "#D7301F", "#7F0000")

theme_umap <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          strip.background = element_blank())
}

ery_types   <- c("earlyEry", "lateEry", "Erythroid")
leuk_types  <- c("LSC", "HSC-like", "Prog-like", "GMP-like", "ProMono-like", "Mono-like", "cDC-like")
other_types <- c("HSC", "Prog", "HSPC", "CMP", "MEP", "GMP", "ProMono", "CD14+ Mono", "CD16+ Mono",
                 "cDC", "pDC", "ProB", "B", "Plasma", "T", "NK", "Stromal")
hspc_keep   <- c("HSC", "Prog", "GMP", "earlyEry", "lateEry", leuk_types)

# ==== Cell-level table ====
build_cell_table <- function(sce, gene_symbol = "SLC6A8", umap = "X_scVI_umap") {
  gid <- rownames(sce)[rowData(sce)$gene_symbol == gene_symbol]
  stopifnot(length(gid) == 1)
  um <- reducedDim(sce, umap)

  out <- as.data.frame(colData(sce)) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.factor), ~ trimws(as.character(.x)))) %>%
    transmute(
      cell_id = colnames(sce),
      Donor, Study,
      status = factor(if_else(ELN.Risk.Group == "Healthy_Donor", "Healthy", "AML"),
                      levels = c("Healthy", "AML")),
      fine = case_when(
        Cell.Type != "HSPC"           ~ Cell.Type,
        HSPC.Cell.Type %in% hspc_keep ~ HSPC.Cell.Type,
        TRUE                          ~ "HSPC"),
      expr  = as.numeric(assay(sce, "X")[gid, ]),
      UMAP1 = um[, 1],
      UMAP2 = um[, 2]) %>%
    mutate(
      category = case_when(
        fine %in% ery_types  ~ "Erythroid",
        fine %in% leuk_types ~ "Leukemic",
        TRUE                 ~ "Other"),
      category = factor(category, levels = c("Erythroid", "Leukemic", "Other")),
      fine     = factor(fine, levels = c(ery_types, leuk_types, other_types)))

  stopifnot(!anyNA(out$fine))
  out
}

cells      <- build_cell_table(dat)
cells_main <- cells %>% filter(!(status == "Healthy" & category == "Leukemic"))

# UMAP grid ====
plot_umap_panel <- function(df_all, df_hl, st, ct, expr_lim, xr, yr) {
  lab <- paste0(st, ": ", ct)
  bg  <- df_all %>% filter(status == st) %>% mutate(panel = lab)
  hl  <- df_hl  %>% filter(status == st, category == ct) %>% mutate(panel = lab)
  hl0 <- hl %>% filter(expr == 0)
  hl1 <- hl %>% filter(expr > 0) %>% arrange(expr)

  ggplot(mapping = aes(UMAP1, UMAP2)) +
    geom_point_rast(data = bg,  colour = "grey92", size = 0.05, raster.dpi = 600) +
    geom_point_rast(data = hl0, colour = "grey60", size = 0.05, raster.dpi = 600) +
    geom_point_rast(data = hl1, aes(colour = expr), size = 0.2, raster.dpi = 600) +
    facet_wrap(~ panel) +
    scale_colour_gradientn(colours = pal_expr, limits = expr_lim, name = "SLC6A8\nlog-norm") +
    coord_fixed(xlim = xr, ylim = yr) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"))
}

plot_umap_grid <- function(df_all, df_hl, assemble = TRUE) {
  expr_lim <- c(0, max(df_hl$expr))
  xr <- range(df_all$UMAP1)
  yr <- range(df_all$UMAP2)
  grid <- expand_grid(st = levels(df_all$status), ct = levels(df_all$category))

  panels <- map2(grid$st, grid$ct, function(st, ct) {
    if (!any(df_hl$status == st & df_hl$category == ct)) return(plot_spacer())
    plot_umap_panel(df_all, df_hl, st, ct, expr_lim, xr, yr)
  })
  if (!assemble) return(panels)
  wrap_plots(panels, nrow = 2, guides = "collect")
}

# ---- Cell-type reference UMAP ----
plot_umap_celltype <- function(df, label = FALSE) {
  set.seed(1)
  p <- ggplot(slice_sample(df, prop = 1), aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, colour = Cell.Type)) +
    geom_point_rast(size = 0.05, raster.dpi = 600) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal_celltype, name = NULL) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3), ncol = 2)) +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_umap()
  if (label) {
    cent <- df %>% group_by(Cell.Type) %>%
      summarise(UMAP1 = median(UMAP1), UMAP2 = median(UMAP2), .groups = "drop")
    p <- p + geom_text(data = cent, aes(label = Cell.Type), colour = "black",
                       size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
      theme(legend.position = "none")
  }
  p
}

# ---- Reference panel: where the categories sit ----
plot_umap_category <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(category = if_else(status == "Healthy" & category == "Leukemic",
                              "Other", as.character(category)),
           category = factor(category, levels = c("Other", "Erythroid", "Leukemic"))) %>%
    arrange(category) %>%
    ggplot(aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, colour = category)) +
    geom_point_rast(size = 0.05, raster.dpi = 600) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal_cat, breaks = c("Erythroid", "Leukemic", "Other"),
                        name = NULL) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())
}
```

```{r fig.width=8.7, fig.height=8.7}
no_leg    <- function(p) p + theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
pct_if_enough <- function(z, min_cells = 20) {
  if (length(z) < min_cells) NA_real_ else 100 * mean(z)
}

# ---- Detection-rate map, split by donor group ----
plot_umap_detection <- function(df, bins = 80, min_cells = 20) {
  ggplot(df, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, z = as.numeric(expr > 0))) +
    stat_summary_hex(fun = pct_if_enough, fun.args = list(min_cells = min_cells), bins = bins) +
    facet_wrap(~ status) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours = pal_rate, na.value = "grey92",
                         name = "% SLC6A8+\ncells") +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          strip.background = element_blank())
}

p_umap2 <- plot_umap_category(cells) + plot_umap_detection(cells, bins = 30, min_cells = 20) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 2))

p_umap2
```

```{r}
# ==== Fig (extended): shared helpers ====
stopifnot(identical(colnames(dat), cells$cell_id))
cells$Cell.Type <- trimws(as.character(dat$Cell.Type))

xr <- range(cells$UMAP1)
yr <- range(cells$UMAP2)
bw <- rep(diff(xr) / 80, 2)

# ---- Detection rate by donor group (replaces previous version) ----
plot_umap_detection <- function(df, bw, xr, yr, min_cells = 20) {
  ggplot(df, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2)) +
    geom_hex(binwidth = bw, fill = "grey92") +
    stat_summary_hex(aes(z = as.numeric(expr > 0)), fun = pct_if_enough,
                     fun.args = list(min_cells = min_cells), binwidth = bw) +
    facet_wrap(~ status) +
    coord_fixed(xlim = xr, ylim = yr) +
    theme_umap()
}

# ---- One grid panel: category cells within one donor group ----
plot_hex_panel <- function(df_all, df_hl, st, ct, bw, xr, yr, min_cells = 20) {
  lab <- paste0(st, ": ", ct)
  bg  <- df_all %>% filter(status == st) %>% mutate(panel = lab)
  hl  <- df_hl  %>% filter(status == st, category == ct) %>% mutate(panel = lab)

  ggplot(mapping = aes(UMAP1, UMAP2)) +
    geom_hex(data = bg, binwidth = bw, fill = "grey92") +
    stat_summary_hex(data = hl, aes(z = as.numeric(expr > 0)), fun = pct_if_enough,
                     fun.args = list(min_cells = min_cells), binwidth = bw, bins = 30) +
    facet_wrap(~ panel) +
    coord_fixed(xlim = xr, ylim = yr) +
    theme_umap()
}

# ---- 2 x 3 grid (Healthy x Leukemic left empty) ----
plot_hex_grid <- function(df_all, df_hl, bw, xr, yr, min_cells = 20) {
  grid <- expand_grid(st = levels(df_all$status), ct = levels(df_all$category))
  map2(grid$st, grid$ct, function(st, ct) {
    if (!any(df_hl$status == st & df_hl$category == ct)) return(plot_spacer())
    plot_hex_panel(df_all, df_hl, st, ct, bw, xr, yr, min_cells)
  })
}

# ---- Shared colour scale across all hex panels ----
has_layers <- function(p) length(p$layers) > 0

hex_max <- function(p) {
  if (!has_layers(p)) return(NA_real_)
  max(layer_data(p, length(p$layers))$value, na.rm = TRUE)
}

add_rate_scale <- function(p, lim) {
  if (!has_layers(p)) return(p)
  p + scale_fill_gradientn(colours = pal_rate, limits = lim, na.value = NA,
                           name = "% SLC6A8+\ncells")
}

# ==== Assemble ====
p_det  <- plot_umap_detection(cells, bw, xr, yr)
p_grid <- plot_hex_grid(cells, cells_main, bw, xr, yr)

lim    <- c(0, max(map_dbl(c(list(p_det), p_grid), hex_max), na.rm = TRUE))
p_det  <- add_rate_scale(p_det, lim)
p_grid <- map(p_grid, add_rate_scale, lim = lim)

top    <- plot_umap_celltype(cells) + plot_umap_category(cells) + p_det +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1, 2))
bottom <- wrap_plots(p_grid, nrow = 2)
p_fig1 <- (top / bottom) + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 2), guides = "collect")
```

### Violin plot

```{r}
plot_violin_strip <- function(df) {
  nz <- df %>% filter(expr > 0)
  sm <- df %>%
    group_by(category, status) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), n_expr = sum(expr > 0), pct = 100 * n_expr / n, .groups = "drop")

  p_v <- ggplot(nz, aes(status, expr, fill = status)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width", alpha = 0.8, colour = NA) +
    geom_jitter_rast(width = 0.15, size = 0.3, alpha = 0.3, raster.dpi = 600) +
    stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.5, linewidth = 0.3) +
    facet_grid(~ category, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal_status, guide = "none") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "SLC6A8 log-norm\n(expressing cells)") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"))

  p_s <- ggplot(sm, aes(status, pct, fill = status)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.6) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f%%\n(%d/%d)", pct, n_expr, n)), vjust = -0.2, size = 4) +
    facet_grid(~ category, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal_status, guide = "none") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.6))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "% expr.") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
    theme(strip.text = element_blank(), strip.background = element_blank())

  p_v / p_s + plot_layout(heights = c(3, 1.6))
}
```

### Dotplot

```{r}
summarise_dot <- function(df, mean_mode = c("all", "nonzero"), min_cells = 50, min_donors = 3) {
  mean_mode <- match.arg(mean_mode)
  df %>%
    group_by(category, fine, status) %>%
    summarise(
      n         = n(),
      n_donors  = n_distinct(Donor),
      pct       = 100 * mean(expr > 0),
      mean_expr = if (mean_mode == "all") log1p(mean(expm1(expr)))
                  else log1p(mean(expm1(expr[expr > 0]))),
      .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(pass = n >= min_cells & n_donors >= min_donors,
           fine = factor(fine, levels = rev(levels(fine))))
}

plot_dot <- function(dd) {
  ggplot(dd, aes(status, fine)) +
    geom_point(data = filter(dd, pass, pct == 0), shape = 1, size = 1, colour = "grey60") +
    geom_point(data = filter(dd, pass, pct > 0), aes(size = pct, colour = mean_expr)) +
    geom_blank() +
    facet_grid(category ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
    scale_size_area(max_size = 8, breaks = c(0.1, 1, 5, 15), name = "% expressing") +
    scale_colour_gradientn(colours = pal_expr, name = "Mean\nlog-norm") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
          strip.background = element_blank())
}
```

